items.title_en: Entrepreneur Opens Unique Salons Where Customers Relax By Being Gently Scratched
items.title_zh: 企业家开设独特的沙龙，顾客可以通过轻轻抓痒来放松身心
items.summary_en: 32-year-old Zhang Xiaochao came up with the idea of turning scratching into a commercial service after watching a short online video of a wife scratching her husband’s back and reading comments from people saying they would pay someone to scratch them like that. As a kid, he loved falling asleep as his father gently scratched his back, so he decided to turn scratching into a business. When he opened his first scratching salon in the Bao’an district of Shenzhen, China, Zhang wasn’t in the best of places. After…
